verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a transcription API with a CLI and desktop app. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for the API, CLI, or GladiaFlow. PII redaction and EU data residency are adjacent privacy features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
